body: A technical background isn’t the only way to become a builder. At Mesa, students learn to use AI tools, mentorship and hands-on projects to turn ideas into working products. The result is an undergraduate experience where students can go from learning to building and launching much earlier than they might expect. Apply now for Mesa’s UG Program.
headline: Non-Tech Students Building Real AI Products at Mesa
